hero-description:
	I humble myself before God and return fully to His presence.
	I repent, I seek His face, and I turn from all unrighteousness.
	God’s mercy and forgiveness RESTORE my soul.
	The glory of the Lord covers my life and family.
	I am purified, renewed, and filled with the Holy Spirit.
	Every barrier is broken, and I receive divine breakthrough.
	My prayers ascend, and heaven responds with grace.
	I dwell in God’s presence on the mountain of glory.
	I walk in obedience, holiness, and victory!
	I am restored, strengthened, and aligned with God’s will.
